display_name: The Orchestration Nucleus / 構築の枢軸：IZAKAYAロジック
summary: The subterranean pulse where raw data meets architectural intent. It is the silent engine room of the world, where the 'Plumbing' of reality is laid and the bridges between disparate platforms are welded in light.

functional_logic.scenario: Massive chrome-plated conduits weaving through ancient obsidian roots, illuminated by high-contrast amber flickering against deep cobalt shadows.

core_cast.name: The Flow-Master (The Plumber)
core_cast.trait: Pragmatic, meticulous, and weary. He views the universe as a series of pipes that must be kept clear to prevent the collapse of the narrative flow.

core_cast.name: Izakaya.Builder
core_cast.trait: Visionary and expansive. Always seeking to map new data structures to ensure that every story has a perfectly compatible home.

functional_logic.rule:
Connectivity is the lifeblood of existence.
Structural integrity precedes narrative manifestation.
The Flow must be optimized; any leak is a loss of soul.

production_dna.visual_anchor: Massive chrome-plated conduits weaving through ancient obsidian roots, illuminated by high-contrast amber flickering against deep cobalt shadows.
